heading.en: Many members of the Church are led into sin by unbelievers—Alma is promised eternal life—Those who repent and are baptized gain forgiveness—Church members in sin who repent and confess to Alma and to the Lord will be forgiven; otherwise, they will not be numbered among the people of the Church. About 120–100 B.C.
heading.sm: E toatele tagata o le Ekalesia ua ta'ita'i atu i le agasala e tagata lē talitonu—Ua folafola mai ia Alema le ola e faavavau—O i latou o ē salamo ma papatiso latou te maua le faamagaloga—O tagata agasala o le Ekalesia o ē ua salamo ma ta'utino atu a latou agasala ia Alema ma le Alii o le a faamagaloina; a lē o lea, o le a lē faitauina i latou faatasi ma tagata o le Ekalesia. E tusa o le 120–100 T.L.M.

words.en: to Alma and to the Lord

verses.en: Now it came to pass that there were many of the rising generation that could not understand the words of king Benjamin, being little children at the time he spake unto his people; and they did not believe the tradition of their fathers.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina sa toatele tupulaga faia’e sa lē mafai ona malamalama i upu a le tupu o Peniamina, ona o ni fanau laiti i latou i le taimi na saunoa mai ai o ia i lona nuu; ma sa latou lē talitonu i uputuu a o latou tamā.

verses.en: They did not believe what had been said concerning the resurrection of the dead, neither did they believe concerning the coming of Christ.
verses.sm: Sa latou lē talitonu i mea sa tautalagia e uiga i le toetutu mai o ē ua oti, pe sa latou talitonu foi e uiga i le afio mai o Keriso.

verses.en: And now because of their unbelief they could not understand the word of God; and their hearts were hardened.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ona o lo latou lē talitonu sa lē mafai ai ona latou malamalama i le afioga a le Atua; ma sa faamaaa o latou loto.

verses.en: And they would not be baptized; neither would they join the church. And they were a separate people as to their faith, and remained so ever after, even in their carnal and sinful state; for they would not call upon the Lord their God.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou lē fia papatiso; pe sa latou fia auai foi i le ekalesia. Ma sa avea i latou o ni tagata ese e tusa ma lo latou faatuatuaga, ma sa faapea ona latou tumau ai mai lena taimi, i lo latou tulaga faaletino ma tumu i le agasala; ona sa latou lē fia valaau atu i le Alii lo latou Atua.

verses.en: And now in the reign of Mosiah they were not half so numerous as the people of God; but because of the dissensions among the brethren they became more numerous.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei i le nofoaiga a Mosaea, sa lē tusa lo latou toatele ma le afa o tagata o le Atua; ae ona o fevaevaea’iga sa i ai i totonu o le au uso, sa oo ina atili faatoateleina ai i latou.

verses.en: For it came to pass that they did deceive many with their flattering words, who were in the church, and did cause them to commit many sins; therefore it became expedient that those who committed sin, that were in the church, should be admonished by the church.
verses.sm: Ona sa oo ina latou faasesēina le toatele o ē sa i ai i le ekalesia, I a latou upu taufaase’e, ma ua mafua ai ona latou faia o agasala e tele; o lea sa tatau ai ia te i latou oē na faia le agasala, o ē sa i ai i le ekalesia, ona a’oa’ia e le ekalesia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they were brought before the priests, and delivered up unto the priests by the teachers; and the priests brought them before Alma, who was the high priest.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina aumai i latou i luma o faitaulaga, ma sa tuu atu i latou i luga i faitaulaga e le ‘au a’oa’o; ma sa aumai i latou e faitaulaga i luma o Alema, o ia o le faitaulaga sili.

verses.en: Now king Mosiah had given Alma the authority over the church.
verses.sm: O lenei sa tuu atu e le tupu o Mosaea ia Alema le pule i luga o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Alma did not know concerning them; but there were many witnesses against them; yea, the people stood and testified of their iniquity in abundance.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa lē iloa e Alema e uiga ia te i latou; peita’i sa i ai ni molimau e toatele e faasaga ia te i latou; ioe, sa tula’i le nuu ma molimau atu i le tele o a latou amioletonu.

verses.en: Now there had not any such thing happened before in the church; therefore Alma was troubled in his spirit, and he caused that they should be brought before the king.
verses.sm: O lenei sa le’i i ai se mea faapea na tupu muamua i le ekalesia; o lea na atuatuvale ai Alema i lona agaga, ma sa faia e ia ia aumai i latou i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: And he said unto the king: Behold, here are many whom we have brought before thee, who are accused of their brethren; yea, and they have been taken in divers iniquities. And they do not repent of their iniquities; therefore we have brought them before thee, that thou mayest judge them according to their crimes.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu o ia i le tupu: Faauta, o le toatele nei o ē ua matou aumai i ou luma, o ē ua tuua’ia e o latou uso; ioe, ma sa maua i latou o latou faia amioletonu eseese. Ma ua latou lē salamo i a latou amioletonu; o lea ua matou aumai ai i latou i ou luma, ina ia mafai ona e faamasino i latou e tusa ma a latou solitulafono.

verses.en: But king Mosiah said unto Alma: Behold, I judge them not; therefore I deliver them into thy hands to be judged.
verses.sm: Peitai sa fai atu le tupu o Mosaea ia Alema: Faauta, ou te lē faamasinoina i latou; o lea ou te tuu atu ai i latou i ou lima ia faamasinoina.

verses.en: And now the spirit of Alma was again troubled; and he went and inquired of the Lord what he should do concerning this matter, for he feared that he should do wrong in the sight of God.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa toe atuatuvale le agaga o Alema; ma sa alu atu o ia ma ole atu i le Alii po o le a le mea e tatau ona ia faia e uiga i lenei mataupu, ona sa mata’u o ia ne’i fai e ia se mea sese i le silafaga a le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that after he had poured out his whole soul to God, the voice of the Lord came to him, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona ia tuuina atu lona agaga atoa i le Atua, sa oo mai le siufofoga o le Alii ia te ia, ua fetalai mai:

verses.en: Blessed art thou, Alma, and blessed are they who were baptized in the waters of Mormon. Thou art blessed because of thy exceeding faith in the words alone of my servant Abinadi.
verses.sm: Amuia lava oe, Alema, ma amuia foi i latou o ē na papatiso i vai o Mamona. Ua e manuia ona o lou faatuatua tele i na’o upu a la’u auauna o Apinati.

verses.en: And blessed are they because of their exceeding faith in the words alone which thou hast spoken unto them.
verses.sm: Ma amuia foi i latou ona o lo latou faatuatua tele i na’o upu na e tautala atu ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And blessed art thou because thou hast established a church among this people; and they shall be established, and they shall be my people.
verses.sm: Ma amuia lava oe ona ua e faatuina se ekalesia i totonu o lenei nuu; ma o le a faatumauina i latou, ma o le a avea i latou ma o’u nuu.

verses.en: Yea, blessed is this people who are willing to bear my name; for in my name shall they be called; and they are mine.
verses.sm: Ioe, amuia lava lenei nuu o ē ua loto e tauave lo’u igoa; ona o lo’u igoa o le a valaau ai i latou; ma e ā a’u i latou.

verses.en: And because thou hast inquired of me concerning the transgressor, thou art blessed.
verses.sm: Ma ona ua e fesili mai ia te a’u e uiga i lē ua solitulafono, ua faamanuiaina oe.

verses.en: Thou art my servant; and I covenant with thee that thou shalt have eternal life; and thou shalt serve me and go forth in my name, and shalt gather together my sheep.
verses.sm: O oe o la’u auauna; ma Ou te osifeagaiga ma oe o le a e maua le ola e faavavau; ma ia e auauna mai ia te a’u ma galue i lo’u igoa, ma faapotopoto faatasi mai a’u mamoe.

verses.en: And he that will hear my voice shall be my sheep; and him shall ye receive into the church, and him will I also receive.
verses.sm: Ma o ia o lē e faalogo mai i lo’u leo o le a avea ma a’u mamoe; ma o ia e talia i le ekalesia, ma o le a Ou talia foi o ia.

verses.en: For behold, this is my church; whosoever is baptized shall be baptized unto repentance. And whomsoever ye receive shall believe in my name; and him will I freely forgive.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, o la’u ekalesia lenei; soo se tasi e papatiso ia papatisoina i le salamo. Ma o soo se tasi tou te talia, ia talitonu i lo’u igoa; ma o le a Ou faamagaloina tuusaoloto o ia.

verses.en: For it is I that taketh upon me the sins of the world; for it is I that hath created them; and it is I that granteth unto him that believeth unto the end a place at my right hand.
verses.sm: Ona o A’u o lē ua aveina i o’u luga agasala a le lalolagi; ona o A’u o lē na foafoaina i latou; ma o A’u o lē na te tuu atu ia te ia o lē e talitonu e oo i le iuga, se nofoaga i lo’u lima taumatau.

verses.en: For behold, in my name are they called; and if they know me they shall come forth, and shall have a place eternally at my right hand.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, o lo’u igoa ua valaau ai i latou; ma afai latou te iloa a’u o le a latou o mai, ma o le a latou maua se nofoaga e faavavau i lo’u lima taumatau.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass that when the second trump shall sound then shall they that never knew me come forth and shall stand before me.
verses.sm: Ma e oo pe a ili mai le pu lona lua, ona o mai lea o i latou o e sa lē iloaina lava a’u ma o le a tutula’i i o’u luma.

w.en: And it shall come to pass

verses.en: And then shall they know that I am the Lord their God, that I am their Redeemer; but they would not be redeemed.
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou iloa i le taimi lena o A’u o le Alii lo latou Atua, o A’u o lo latou Togiola; peitai sa latou lē mananao e togiolaina i latou.

verses.en: And then I will confess unto them that I never knew them; and they shall depart into ever lasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou ta’utino atu ia te i latou i le taimi lena sa Ou lē iloaina lava i latou; ma o le a latou o atu i le afi e faavavau ua saunia mo le tiapolo ma ana agelu.

verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, that he that will not hear my voice, the same shall ye not receive into my church, for him I will not receive at the last day.
verses.sm: O lea Ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, o ia o lē e lē faalogo mai i lo’u leo, o ia lava lea ia outou lē taliaina i la’u ekalesia, ona o ia lea o le a Ou lē taliaina i le aso gataaga.

verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, Go; and whosoever transgresseth against me, him shall ye judge according to the sins which he has committed; and if he confess his sins before thee and me, and repenteth in the sincerity of his heart, him shall ye forgive, and I will forgive him also.
verses.sm: O lea Ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, Alu ia; ma o soo se tasi e solitulafono faasaga mai ia te a’u, ia e faamasinoina o ia e tusa ma agasala ua faia e ia; ma afai e ta’utino mai e ia ana agasala i luma o oe ma a’u, ma ua salamo i le faamaoni o lona loto, ia e faamagaloina o ia, ma o le a Ou faamagaloina foi o ia.

verses.en: Yea, and as often as my people repent will I forgive them their trespasses against me.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o le tele o taimi e salamo ai lo’u nuu Ou te faamagalo ai i latou ia latou solitulafono faasaga mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And ye shall also forgive one another your trespasses; for verily I say unto you, he that forgiveth not his neighbor’s trespasses when he says that he repents, the same hath brought himself under condemnation.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou faamagalo foi le tasi i le isi i a outou solitulafono; auā e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o ia o lē e lē faamagalo atu i solitulafono a lē la te tuaoi pe a fai mai o ia ua salamo, o ia lava lea ua ia aumai o ia lava i lalo i le ta’usalaga.

verses.en: Now I say unto you, Go; and whosoever will not repent of his sins the same shall not be numbered among my people; and this shall be observed from this time forward.
verses.sm: O lenei Ou te fai atu ia te oe, Alu ia; ma o soo se tasi e lē fia salamo i ana agasala, o ia lava lea o le a lē faitauina i totonu o lo’u nuu; ma o le a tausia lenei mea mai le taimi nei agai i luma.

verses.en: And it came to pass when Alma had heard these words he wrote them down that he might have them, and that he might judge the people of that church according to the command– ments of God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona faalogo o Alema i nei upu sa tusi e ia i lalo ina ia mafai ona maua e ia, ma ina ia mafai ona faamasino e ia tagata o lena ekalesia e tusa ma poloaiga a le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Alma went and judged those that had been taken in iniquity, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina alu atu Alema ma faamasino i latou o ē na maua o amioletonu, e tusa ma le afioga a le Alii.

verses.en: And whosoever repented of their sins and did confess them, them he did number among the people of the church;
verses.sm: Ma soo se tasi sa salamo i a latou agasala ma ta’utino mai i latou, o i latou ia na faitau e ia i totonu o tagata o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And those that would not confess their sins and repent of their iniquity, the same were not numbered among the people of the church, and their names were blotted out.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e sa lē fia ta’utino mai a latou agasala ma salamo i a latou amioletonu, o i latou lava ia sa lē faitauina i totonu o tagata o le ekalesia, ma sa soloiesea o latou igoa.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Alma did regulate all the affairs of the church; and they began again to have peace and to prosper exceedingly in the affairs of the church, walking circumspectly before God, receiving many, and baptizing many.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina pulea e Alema mataupu uma o le ekalesia; ma sa amata ona latou toe maua o le filemu ma le manuia tele i mataupu o le ekalesia, ma savavali ma le faaeteete i luma o le Atua, ma talia le toatele, ma papatiso foi le toatele.

verses.en: And now all these things did Alma and his fellow laborers do who were over the church, walking in all diligence, teaching the word of God in all things, suffering all manner of afflictions, being persecuted by all those who did not belong to the church of God.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o nei mea uma sa faia e Alema ma ona uso-a-auauna o ē sa ta’ita’i i le ekalesia, ma savavali ma le filigā atoa, ma a’oa’o atu le afioga a le Atua i mea uma, ma mafatia i ituaiga uma o puapuaga eseese, ma sauāina e i latou uma o e sa lē auai i le ekalesia a le Atua.

verses.en: And they did admonish their brethren; and they were also admonished, every one by the word of God, according to his sins, or to the sins which he had committed, being commanded of God to pray without ceasing, and to give thanks in all things.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tima’ia o latou uso; ma sa tima’ia foi i latou uma taitoatasi, i le afioga a le Atua, e tusa ma ana agasala, po o agasala na ia faia, ma sa poloa’iina e le Atua ia tatalo e lē aunoa, ma ia avatu le faafetai i mea uma.
